name: z-wbe-bottleneck-lab
description: Z-WBE Bottleneck Lab - Change the assumptions. See what breaks first.

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'dist', {recursive: true});"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix shared run typecheck && npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
